invoices_issued_is_complete.name: invoices_issued_is_complete
invoices_issued_is_complete.value: ("billing"."invoices"."issued_at" IS NULL) = ("billing"."invoices"."number" IS NULL) AND (("billing"."invoices"."issued_at" IS NULL) = ("billing"."invoices"."issue_date" IS NULL))

invoices_reverse_charge_needs_vat.name: invoices_reverse_charge_needs_vat
invoices_reverse_charge_needs_vat.value: "billing"."invoices"."vat_treatment" <> 'reverse_charge' OR "billing"."invoices"."issued_at" IS NULL OR "billing"."invoices"."client_vat_number" IS NOT NULL

projects_retainer_has_terms.name: projects_retainer_has_terms
projects_retainer_has_terms.value: "crm"."projects"."billing_model" <> 'retainer' OR ("crm"."projects"."retainer_amount_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "crm"."projects"."retainer_period" IS NOT NULL)

projects_dates_ordered.name: projects_dates_ordered
projects_dates_ordered.value: "crm"."projects"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "crm"."projects"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "crm"."projects"."ends_on" >= "crm"."projects"."starts_on"

projects_amounts_non_negative.name: projects_amounts_non_negative
projects_amounts_non_negative.value:
("crm"."projects"."default_rate_cents" IS NULL OR "crm"."projects"."default_rate_cents" >= 0) AND
      ("crm"."projects"."budget_amount_cents" IS NULL OR "crm"."projects"."budget_amount_cents" >= 0) AND
      ("crm"."projects"."retainer_amount_cents" IS NULL OR "crm"."projects"."retainer_amount_cents" >= 0)

documents_has_a_home.name: documents_has_a_home
documents_has_a_home.value: "docs"."documents"."client_id" IS NOT NULL OR "docs"."documents"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

attendees_consent_has_time.name: attendees_consent_has_time
attendees_consent_has_time.value: "meetings"."attendees"."consent" IS NULL OR "meetings"."attendees"."consent_at" IS NOT NULL

notes_ends_after_start.name: notes_ends_after_start
notes_ends_after_start.value: "meetings"."notes"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "meetings"."notes"."started_at" IS NULL OR "meetings"."notes"."ended_at" >= "meetings"."notes"."started_at"

contracts_ends_after_starts.name: contracts_ends_after_starts
contracts_ends_after_starts.value: "sales"."contracts"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "sales"."contracts"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "sales"."contracts"."ends_on" >= "sales"."contracts"."starts_on"

quotes_sent_is_complete.name: quotes_sent_is_complete
quotes_sent_is_complete.value: ("sales"."quotes"."sent_at" IS NULL) = ("sales"."quotes"."number" IS NULL) AND (("sales"."quotes"."sent_at" IS NULL) = ("sales"."quotes"."issue_date" IS NULL))

quotes_decided_needs_sent.name: quotes_decided_needs_sent
quotes_decided_needs_sent.value: "sales"."quotes"."decided_at" IS NULL OR "sales"."quotes"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL

quotes_tm_needs_rate.name: quotes_tm_needs_rate
quotes_tm_needs_rate.value: "sales"."quotes"."billing_model" <> 'time_and_materials' OR "sales"."quotes"."sent_at" IS NULL OR "sales"."quotes"."hourly_rate_cents" IS NOT NULL

entries_one_running_per_person.name: entries_one_running_per_person
entries_one_running_per_person.where: "time"."entries"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "time"."entries"."ended_at" IS NULL

entries_billable_needs_target.name: entries_billable_needs_target
entries_billable_needs_target.value: "time"."entries"."billable" = false OR "time"."entries"."project_id" IS NOT NULL OR "time"."entries"."client_id" IS NOT NULL

entries_end_needs_start.name: entries_end_needs_start
entries_end_needs_start.value: "time"."entries"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "time"."entries"."started_at" IS NOT NULL

entries_invoiced_needs_invoice.name: entries_invoiced_needs_invoice
entries_invoiced_needs_invoice.value: "time"."entries"."invoiced_at" IS NULL OR "time"."entries"."invoice_id" IS NOT NULL

entries_measurable_or_running.name: entries_measurable_or_running
entries_measurable_or_running.value: "time"."entries"."minutes" IS NOT NULL OR ("time"."entries"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "time"."entries"."ended_at" IS NULL)
